name: Spinal Epidural Abscess
definition: Purulent infection in the spinal epidural space that can cause rapidly progressive neural compression, sepsis and permanent neurological injury.

typical: Fever may be present or absent

redFlags.item: Any suspected spinal epidural abscess with neurological deficit

investigations.principle: Urgent laboratory and imaging assessment is required when SEA is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Contrast-enhanced MRI of the relevant spine is the preferred test; image more extensive regions when clinically indicated.
investigations.radiographs: Plain radiographs are insensitive early and cannot exclude SEA.

green: Prompt antimicrobial therapy and surgical evaluation when indicated
amber: Do not delay emergency imaging or decompression for conservative or Ayurvedic therapy.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Any Vata/Shotha or infection-related Ayurvedic description is secondary; emergency modern infection and neural-compression management takes priority.

patientEducation.summary: Purulent infection in the spinal epidural space that can cause rapidly progressive neural compression, sepsis and permanent neurological injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, breathing/swallowing difficulty, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
